audit.vintage: current numerical vintage; historical values may be revised

protocol.deadline: 16:00 America/Toronto on the preceding Canadian banking business day
protocol.historical_test_status: release-date-aware reconstruction using current numerical vintages; not an untouched prospective test
protocol.market_benchmark: not available; no meeting-specific timestamped OIS feed
protocol.model: StandardScaler followed by multinomial logistic regression
protocol.model_selection: fixed specification; do not tune on these evaluation outcomes
protocol.same_day_macro_releases: excluded because the source calendar has day precision
protocol.target: direction at the next scheduled Bank of Canada policy announcement
protocol.text_features: not used; no verified publication-time corpus
